svg.title: Original classroom scale plan with doorway and board
svg.desc: First-party classroom plan of a room 8 meters long and 6 meters wide, drawn at a scale factor of 1 drawing centimeter per actual meter. The rectangle on the page has width 176 pixels and height 132 pixels at 22 pixels per drawing centimeter. A one-meter doorway is represented by an open 22-pixel gap on the lower wall and a three-meter board by a separate 66-pixel line on the upper wall. Students must independently measure, label, exchange and revise plans; the reference model is not a submitted school-specific plan.
svg.text: Original classroom model: 1 drawing cm = 1 actual m
Teacher checks an independently measured and revised student floor plan.
